description: Conformance vectors for the tracked-push extension to the weir v1 wire protocol: message types PushTracked (0x06) and AckTracked (0x07), and the RecordCoordinate payload an AckTracked carries. Kept apart from wire_v1_vectors.json, which is frozen and is read by decoders that know only message types 0x01..0x05 — such a decoder is CORRECT to reject a 0x06 frame, and stays conformant by ignoring this file. 'frame_vectors' are complete frames; 'coordinate_vectors' are bare AckTracked payloads.

frame_vectors.name: push_tracked_hello
frame_vectors.notes: PushTracked of "hello" at Durable durability. Byte-for-byte a Push frame except for the message_type byte (0x06 instead of 0x01) and the header CRC that covers it.

frame_vectors.name: push_tracked_buffered
frame_vectors.notes: PushTracked at Buffered durability. Every tier is available to a tracked push; the tier still decides durability, the coordinate only says where the record went.

frame_vectors.name: ack_tracked_hello
frame_vectors.notes: The daemon's reply to `push_tracked_hello`: an AckTracked whose payload is the record's coordinate. The durability byte is fixed filler (0x01) exactly as it is on a plain Ack.

coordinate_vectors.name: coordinate_hello
coordinate_vectors.notes: The coordinate carried by `ack_tracked_hello`. The record_id is sha256(segment_len ++ segment ++ index ++ payload_len ++ payload) over the payload "hello" — the same value the drain hands the sink as its per-record idempotency key.

coordinate_vectors.name: coordinate_empty_segment
coordinate_vectors.notes: Boundary: a zero-length segment name is structurally legal (the daemon never emits one, but a decoder must not special-case it into a rejection).

coordinate_vectors.name: coordinate_max_segment
coordinate_vectors.notes: Boundary: a segment name at the 255-byte cap, which makes the payload exactly 298 bytes — the largest AckTracked a conformant daemon sends, and the number a reader caps its allocation at.

coordinate_vectors.name: reject_coordinate_truncated
coordinate_vectors.notes: Shorter than the fixed prefix every coordinate has. Rejected before any field offset is interpreted.

coordinate_vectors.name: reject_coordinate_unknown_version
coordinate_vectors.notes: Leading version byte is 0x02. The version leads the payload so a reader meeting a layout it does not know rejects it instead of mis-parsing it.

coordinate_vectors.name: reject_coordinate_trailing_bytes
coordinate_vectors.notes: One byte past the declared length. The buffer must be EXACTLY one coordinate — quietly using the prefix is how a layout disagreement becomes a wrong address.

coordinate_vectors.name: reject_coordinate_segment_too_long
coordinate_vectors.notes: Declares a segment name over the 255-byte cap. Rejected on the declared length, before the buffer is consulted.

coordinate_vectors.name: reject_coordinate_not_utf8
coordinate_vectors.notes: Segment name bytes are not valid UTF-8.
